item.title: Winter weather advisory issued for Campbell County as snow moves in
item.description: GILLETTE, Wyo. — Snow and strong winds are expected to impact Campbell County beginning late Wednesday, with hazardous travel possible through Thursday, according to the National Weather Service in Rapid City, South Dakota.
